claim_decisions.claim: A 2012 fMRI study involved fourteen meditation practitioners
claim_decisions.limitation: Explicit task context; cannot infer product efficacy

claim_decisions.claim: Four analysis intervals: wandering, awareness, shifting, sustained focus
claim_decisions.limitation: Researcher model; intervals approximate button presses

claim_decisions.claim: Default-mode-related activation during inferred mind-wandering phases
claim_decisions.limitation: Association, not a neural readout of thought content

claim_decisions.claim: Awareness, shifting and sustained intervals had differentiated networks
claim_decisions.limitation: Method is fMRI correlational within task

claim_decisions.claim: Higher meditation experience associated with different connectivity
claim_decisions.limitation: Cross-sectional association not necessarily training causation

claim_decisions.claim: A two-week randomized mindfulness course improved certain tested task outcomes
claim_decisions.limitation: Does not generalize to single audio session

claim_decisions.claim: The 2024 synthesis included 111 RCTs and 9538 participants
claim_decisions.limitation: Across varied mindfulness-based interventions

claim_decisions.claim: The synthesis reported small-to-moderate effects in some domains
claim_decisions.limitation: Effect sizes and controls vary

claim_decisions.claim: No effects on several other measured cognitive outcomes in synthesis
claim_decisions.limitation: Do not imply universal cognitive uplift

claim_decisions.claim: Self-guided interventions uniformly match face-to-face programs
claim_decisions.limitation: Study suggested effect modification; exclude

claim_decisions.claim: Zen12 Premium is described as twelve levels and 48 MP3 recordings
claim_decisions.limitation: Needs entitlement/delivery verification

claim_decisions.claim: Zen12 supplies four styles per level
claim_decisions.limitation: Music, guided, nature, white noise; no product-use claim

claim_decisions.claim: Each Zen12 meditation session takes twelve minutes
claim_decisions.limitation: Seller description; exact downloaded audio not inspected

claim_decisions.claim: Official Premium page displayed $87.99 on 2026-11-05
claim_decisions.limitation: Not a price promise; checkout total unknown

claim_decisions.claim: Alternate official promotion advertises a different amount
claim_decisions.limitation: No eligibility, stacking or expiry assumption

claim_decisions.claim: Official page advertised one-year refund guarantee
claim_decisions.limitation: Refund service and legal terms untested

claim_decisions.claim: Program includes quick-start guide, manual, support and other bonuses
claim_decisions.limitation: Individual entitlement unverified

claim_decisions.claim: Zen12 delivers benefits of an hour of meditation in 12 minutes
claim_decisions.limitation: Seller's claim not substantiated by cited trials; exclude

claim_decisions.claim: The precise Zen12 audio was independently tested by Final Vestige
claim_decisions.limitation: Do not claim experience or testing

claim_decisions.claim: Zen12 automatically eliminates mind wandering
claim_decisions.limitation: No product-specific controlled efficacy; exclude

claim_decisions.claim: Zen12 guarantees reduction in anxiety, illness or cognitive impairment
claim_decisions.limitation: Exclude medical benefits absent appropriate product-specific evidence

claim_decisions.claim: Any brainwave modulation has permanent beneficial clinical outcomes
claim_decisions.limitation: Exclude

claim_decisions.claim: The public Inspire3 affiliate program exists
claim_decisions.limitation: Not proof of FV account admission

claim_decisions.claim: Final Vestige has approval for Zen12 web and email promotions
claim_decisions.limitation: Named authorization, channel permissions and creatives unknown

claim_decisions.claim: An FV-specific affiliate tracking link is authorized
claim_decisions.limitation: Must not invent/activate earning URL

claim_decisions.claim: An advertiser may compensate a referring publisher
claim_decisions.limitation: Near-link plain-language disclosure needed if a link is ever activated

claim_decisions.claim: An affiliate click or email subscription is an actual paid sale
claim_decisions.limitation: Merchant confirmation necessary

claim_decisions.claim: The public Focus Fieldbook is an existing first-party free route
claim_decisions.limitation: Stored Jetpack block exists but guest delivery not verified

claim_decisions.claim: Puységur historic reports prove commercial hypnosis efficacy
claim_decisions.limitation: Do not infer

claim_decisions.claim: New mind-wandering exercise quantifies total mental distraction
claim_decisions.limitation: Measures noticed moments only; not a validated test

claim_decisions.claim: The optional video has been rendered, watched or A/B tested
claim_decisions.limitation: Only an unproduced storyboard/transcript; no media or experiment

claim_decisions.claim: Any observed price is a guaranteed checkout total
claim_decisions.limitation: Checkout taxes, discounts, currency, upsells untested

claim_decisions.claim: Free Focus CTA is an independently verified completed subscriber conversion
claim_decisions.limitation: Guest confirmation and delivery test required

claim_decisions.claim: Qualified Grok asset IDs and attributed purchases are known
claim_decisions.limitation: Reconcile TASK-008; leave identifiers and economics null
